SELECT AVG(per_rating_avg_length) AS avg_of_rating_avg_lengths, AVG(per_rating_avg_ratio) AS avg_of_rating_avg_ratios
FROM (
  SELECT rating,
         AVG(length) AS per_rating_avg_length,
         AVG(rental_rate / replacement_cost) AS per_rating_avg_ratio
  FROM film
  WHERE replacement_cost >= 20.99
    AND length IS NOT NULL
    AND rental_rate IS NOT NULL
    AND replacement_cost IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY rating
) AS rating_averages
